verdict.rationale: Orrick has a dedicated Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation practice group page describing compliance work across global data regulations and incident response recognition, plus a self-service 'Privacy in a Box' tool addressing legal compliance on data. This documents a real, named practice with tooling, though evidence doesn't specifically confirm GDPR/CCPA/DPDP-Act-by-name coverage or independent corroboration of quality. Missing for 10: explicit named coverage of GDPR/CCPA/DPDP Act statutes, client/independent testimonials specific to the privacy practice, and India-specific privacy-law detail.
